_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::sti#1, sharpened by execution. The entry offered temperature scaling in MAT_electrode OR MAT_soret as the route to a two-way coupling. Upstream sti_mono_3D_hex8_elch_s2i_butlervolmerpeltier_adiabatic_mortar_standard.4C.yaml has NO temperature-scaling functions active at all (UPSTREAM_TEMP_SCALE_FUNCTS_ACTIVE=0, every DIFF_COEF_TEMP_SCALE_FUNCT and COND_TEMP_SCALE_FUNCT is 0) and is still two-way: setting MAT_soret's SORET to 0 moves 14 of its 40 result tests, and raising SORET by three decades moves 16, including both scatra and thermo quantities. SORET is the knob. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the OFF arm: leave SORET as shipped. The thermo->scatra flux is unchanged, every result test passes, EXIT_OFF becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the STRONG arm: leave SORET as shipped. Nothing moves, EXIT_STRONG becomes 0 and both MOVES_ counters go to zero, so the fixture must go red.
